title: stipa pennata subsp. okensis
intro: Stipa pennata subsp. okensis, commonly known as the Siberian feather grass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the grass family, Poaceae. It is native to Russia and China, and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Stipa pennata subsp. okensis include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
